subject: Observability add-ons: retention / tracing / dashboards — pricing and pilot packaging
messages:
From: Anita Kapoor <anita.kapoor@novaprod.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novaprod.com>, procurement@novaprod.com
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability add-ons — retention/tracing/dashboard questions

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team liked the low-latency inference bake and the tracing UI. Before we move to procurement, we need a clearer picture on add-on pricing for:
- Long-term retention (30/90/365 day buckets)
- Distributed tracing (ingest & storage meters)
- Advanced dashboards (seat/visualization tiering)

Attached is a short workbook with our expected volumes and which features we care about (Novaprod-observability-requirements.xlsx). Our legal/procurement timeline is tight — we hope to have commercial terms by the end of April.

Can you please:
1) Send a compact SKU matrix that maps retention buckets + trace ingest + dashboard seats to a price and any crediting rules.
2) Confirm whether you offer pilot credits for the first 90 days and if those credits apply to tracing ingest.
3) Call out any hard limits (e.g., dashboard seats, retention tiers that require pilot commitment).

Appreciate it — can you loop in anyone on billing or sales engineering who should be aware?

Best,
Anita Kapoor
Head of Platform, Novaprod
Attachments: Novaprod-observability-requirements.xlsx

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Kapoor <anita.kapoor@novaprod.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — retention/tracing/dashboard questions

Hi Anita — thanks for the workbook and the clear asks. Short answers up front, details below and a compact proposal attached (soojin_proposal_v1.pdf).

Quick responses:
- We can provide a SKU matrix that splits retention into 30/90/365-day buckets, with a per-GB/month charge plus a small fixed replication fee for long-term storage.
- Tracing is metered by ingest (events/sec) and retention; pilot credits can be applied to tracing ingest for the first 90 days (we typically cap pilot credits to 50K events/day unless agreed otherwise).
- Dashboards have two pricing levers: "viewer seats" (free) and "editor seats" (priced by seat). Advanced visualization packs are an add-on SKU.

Attached is a short proposal that shows two pack options:
A) Small pilot — 3-month pilot, 20% credit applied to retention & tracing ingest (up to a limit), dashboards included at up to 10 editor seats.
B) Enterprise pilot — 3-month pilot, 30% credit for the first quarter with a committed minimal monthly usage floor and simplified per-GB slab pricing for retention.

Ben (cc) will jump in with the SKU matrix and the tiered discount table. If this looks promising I'd suggest a quick sync Monday to finalize which pilot lane and the SOW path.

Notes: HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/3921 — if you want, we can send a short SOW draft and a DocuSign link to speed procurement.

Thanks,
So,
Soojin Lee
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | redwood.ai
Attachments: soojin_proposal_v1.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Kapoor <anita.kapoor@novaprod.com>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — retention/tracing/dashboard questions

Anita — following up with the SKU matrix attached (obs-addon-sku-matrix.csv). Summary of the three pricing levers and example math below: 

1) Retention (per GB / month)
- 30-day: $0.08 / GB / mo
- 90-day: $0.05 / GB / mo
- 365-day: $0.02 / GB / mo (archive slab) + $0.005 replication fee / GB / mo

2) Tracing
- Ingest: $0.30 / million spans ingested (metered by span count)
- Retention: same per-GB slabs as above when traces are retained beyond 7 days

3) Advanced dashboards
- Editor seat: $45 / seat / mo
- Advanced viz pack: $1,200 / month per workspace (includes 10 heavy widgets)

Pilot proposals:
- Pilot A (no commit): 3 months, 20% credit applied to retention and trace ingest up to $8K total credit; dashboards included up to 10 editor seats.
- Pilot B (with light commit): 3 months, 30% credit applied to first quarter up to $20K credit; if you convert to yearly commit within 30 days we apply an additional one-time onboarding credit.

Open items for procurement: whether credits need to flow as invoice credits vs. upfront discount, and whether Novaprod requires an audit clause for retention beyond 365 days.

Attachment: obs-addon-sku-matrix.csv

—Ben
Ben Carter
Commercial Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Anita Kapoor <anita.kapoor@novaprod.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, procurement@novaprod.com, Samir Patel <samir.patel@novaprod.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — retention/tracing/dashboard questions

Thanks Ben — that SKU matrix is helpful. A few clarifying points from procurement and platform: 

- Procurement prefers credits to be reflected as invoice-level line-item discounts (so we can show them in our ledger). Is that possible?
- For the pilot we want tracing ingest to be covered fully by the pilot credits (we expect spikes during onboarding) — can the pilot ingest cap be raised to 150K events/day if we sign the SOW this week?
- We need the SLA for dashboard availability (SLA target 99.9%) and RTO for archived traces; can you clarify those clauses?

We can do a quick call Wednesday afternoon to align commercial terms and get the SOW moving. I've attached a draft SOW from our side (Novaprod-SOW-draft.pdf) with a few redlines.

If you can confirm the invoice-credit flow and the raised ingest cap, procurement is happy to move quickly.

Regards,
Anita
Head of Platform, Novaprod
Attachments: Novaprod-SOW-draft.pdf

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Kapoor <anita.kapoor@novaprod.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — retention/tracing/dashboard questions

Hi Anita — great, thanks for the specifics and the SOW draft. Quick confirmations and next steps: 

- Invoice credits: yes — we can surface pilot credits as an invoice line-item discount. Laura (cc) will own the billing flow and confirm contract language for how credits are applied on the invoice.
- Pilot ingest cap: Ben supports raising the pilot ingest cap to 150K events/day for the 90-day pilot if Novaprod signs the SOW by EOD Thursday. We'll note a soft overage protection: if you sustain >150K/day for more than 7 consecutive days we'll flag and review.
- SLA: dashboards — we can commit to a 99.9% availability SLA for the hosted dashboards in the Hosted API plan; archived traces RTO is dependent on tier (30/90/365) — standard archive restore SLA is 6 hours for 30/90-day tiers and up to 24 hours for 365-day archive. We'll include the exact wording in the SOW appendix.

Next steps:
1) Laura will send a short billing note that maps how pilot credits show on the invoice and the DocuSign SOW link.
2) Ben to provide a one-page engineering note on overage handling for tracing ingest.
3) We target to have a signed SOW and DocuSign return by Friday if possible; once signed we activate the pilot account and apply credits.

Call: Wednesday 3:00pm PT works for us — I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looping Laura in now.

Best,
So,
Soojin Lee
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Onwards — cc: Laura Bennett (Billing)
